decisions.statement: The pages carrying a key are the pages of every page type named and of every type beneath.
A page stating no value under that key is left out rather than answered.
A page reached under two page types is answered once.
A count handed in holds how many pages are answered.
The value each page states under that key is answered beside that page's path.
The key a record property's records sit under is the slug that property's page states.
The pages stating those records are the pages of every page type declaring the record.
The files of entries under a shape are the files beside every page stating that shape's key.
A file the world holds no body for is left out.
A record or a shape no page type declares reaches no page here.
Which page types declare a property is read from the index rather than a body.
The files beside one page are answered without reaching any other page.
The files beside a page are the uncommitted files where the caller asks for those.
No page body is read here.
Nothing here answers a passage or an edit.

definition: which pages carry a page property's values, and which files beside them hold them
